scope: Current native handoff attainability and value; diagnostic experiment, not replacement M6 qualification
questions: Matched initial replica set: handoff versus forced safe Fresh
Exclusive preparation costs and observer perturbation
Alternate depletion across four published generations
Payload capacity benefit at a fixed two-replica budget
product_policy: No production edits before sufficient removable-time budget is established. Diagnostic fallback only declines handoff before any preparation; no safety checks removed. All original gate failures remain.

variants.fresh: one initial exact replica, original selector
variants.handoff: two initial exact replicas, original selector
variants.matched: two initial exact replicas, diagnostic image declines handoff before preparation; original Fresh path

endpoint: Each operation: transaction and mutation begin, K writes, seal and canonical commit. Separate setup, validation/close and explicit reclamation drain; complete sample wall is also recorded.
work: N=K; H=0 retained history roots but one exact original view and a per-operation exact current view. 64x64 pages, B4 or B16. Preserve covers full payload through a mutable guard; partial writes one row; payload passes complete input to overwritePage. All old/new bytes, payload work and physical increments checked.

timing_matrix.order: rotate cases by block; rotate variants in six permutations twice; sequential processes
timing_matrix.statistic: process medians; within-block paired log ratios and absolute savings; 20000 paired block bootstrap resamples seed261006; two-sided95% descriptive intervals, no family qualification
timing_matrix.stop: exact fixed size; no optional extension or exclusion; any correctness, process or identity failure stops and is retained

cuts.mode0: cuts disabled; operation wall and threadCPU only
cuts.mode1: fixture coarse wall/CPU and diagnostic nested exclusive wall
cuts.mode2: fixture coarse wall/CPU plus diagnostic nested exclusive wall/CPU
cuts.meaning: Independent exclusive scopes subtract nested children. Parent inclusive numbers retained separately. Mode0 versus1/2 quantifies observer effect; no instrumented duration is a necessary lower bound. wall minus CPU includes scheduling/clock effects, not identified mutex waits.

calibration: Six blocks per architecture compare unchanged production image versus diagnostic image with forceFresh=false and timing disabled, K16 preserve, fresh/handoff, 40 samples/8 warmup. CPU busy-loop calibration both architectures; Rosetta CPU coverage not assumed.
capacity: Both architectures, three variants, K16/B4/preserve, one operation, provider budget exactly2*K*pageBytes. matched Fresh must refuse safely, handoff and one-replica Fresh must complete. Never counted as speedup.
identities: Record before/after hashes of production sources, real libraries, probes, scripts, Qt; verify loaded diagnostic or production image in each process; save exit, timeout, reap and all failures.
decision: Select implementation only if a legal complete responsibility has evidence supporting enough y-0.7x budget for the remaining gap. Otherwise close diagnosis with a gate/value recommendation, not another speculative container rewrite. A candidate upper budget below the gap rejects that candidate, not all conceivable algorithms.
